-- Andromeda Tech Factory V1 -- MANUAL installation only, MariaDB 10.4+ / InnoDB.
-- The owner runs this file in phpMyAdmin, in the LOCAL Andromeda database.
-- No application component executes this DDL. Do not edit/import andromeda.sql.
-- Back up before manual installation. DDL implicitly commits in MariaDB.
-- Existing rows/quantities/unlocked halls are NEVER reset on a second run.
-- IF NOT EXISTS is not an upgrade for an incompatible table: the services check
-- column types and indexes and fail closed; inspect the verification below.
-- users.id is signed INT in the supplied dump. No foreign keys are added: this
-- avoids changing existing tables or coupling their deletion policy to history.
-- DATETIME fields below store UTC, independent of the connection time zone.
-- Generic halls: no permanent tech_id on slots. One build produces one unit.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_tech_inventory (
  player_id INT NOT NULL,
  tech_id TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  amount INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cooldown_until DATETIME(6) NULL,
  active_until DATETIME(6) NULL,
  active_use_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
  version BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (player_id, tech_id),
  CONSTRAINT tf_inventory_id CHECK (tech_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  CONSTRAINT tf_inventory_amount CHECK (amount <= 2147483647)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_tech_slots (
  player_id INT NOT NULL,
  slot_no TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  unlocked_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
  unlock_request_key CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
  unlock_paid_uridium BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (player_id, slot_no),
  UNIQUE KEY tf_unlock_request (player_id, unlock_request_key),
  CONSTRAINT tf_slot_no CHECK (slot_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_tech_builds (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  player_id INT NOT NULL,
  slot_no TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  tech_id TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  request_key CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  active_slot_no TINYINT UNSIGNED NULL,
  started_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  ends_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  credited_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
  recipe_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  paid_credits BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  paid_uridium BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  paid_seprom BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  paid_logfiles BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY tf_build_request (player_id, request_key),
  UNIQUE KEY tf_active_slot (player_id, active_slot_no),
  KEY tf_due (player_id, credited_at, ends_at),
  CONSTRAINT tf_build_tech CHECK (tech_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  CONSTRAINT tf_build_slot CHECK (slot_no BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  CONSTRAINT tf_build_dates CHECK (ends_at >= started_at),
  CONSTRAINT tf_build_delivery CHECK (
    (credited_at IS NULL AND active_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND active_slot_no = slot_no)
    OR (credited_at IS NOT NULL AND active_slot_no IS NULL)
  )
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_tech_use_events (
  use_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  player_id INT NOT NULL,
  tech_id TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  reserved_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  resolved_at DATETIME(6) NULL,
  session_generation CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  state VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  details VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (use_id),
  KEY tf_use_player (player_id, reserved_at),
  KEY tf_use_review (state, reserved_at),
  CONSTRAINT tf_use_tech CHECK (tech_id BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  CONSTRAINT tf_use_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','applied','needs_review','compensated'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- DATA seed only. Missing rows are also initialized transactionally by services
-- for future accounts. Duplicate keys are a no-op, not an inventory reset.
START TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO player_tech_slots (player_id, slot_no, unlocked_at)
SELECT u.id, s.slot_no, IF(s.slot_no = 1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL)
FROM users u CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS slot_no UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) s
ORDER BY u.id, s.slot_no
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE player_id = VALUES(player_id);

INSERT INTO player_tech_inventory (player_id, tech_id, amount)
SELECT u.id, t.tech_id, 0
FROM users u CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT 1 AS tech_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5) t
ORDER BY u.id, t.tech_id
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE player_id = VALUES(player_id);
COMMIT;

-- Verification only: explicitly target andromeda, even if phpMyAdmin changes
-- the current schema to information_schema after showing metadata results.
-- Inspect the result sets; this section does not repair, reset, relock or delete.
SELECT TABLE_NAME, ENGINE FROM information_schema.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'andromeda' AND TABLE_NAME IN
 ('users','player_skylab_state','player_skylab_modules','skylab_module_levels',
  'player_tech_inventory','player_tech_slots','player_tech_builds','player_tech_use_events');
SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE
FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'andromeda'
AND TABLE_NAME IN ('player_tech_inventory','player_tech_slots','player_tech_builds','player_tech_use_events')
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;
SELECT TABLE_NAME, INDEX_NAME, NON_UNIQUE, GROUP_CONCAT(COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY SEQ_IN_INDEX) AS columns_in_order
FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'andromeda'
AND TABLE_NAME IN ('player_tech_inventory','player_tech_slots','player_tech_builds','player_tech_use_events')
GROUP BY TABLE_NAME, INDEX_NAME, NON_UNIQUE;
SELECT u.id AS player_with_missing_rows FROM `andromeda`.`users` u
LEFT JOIN (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) n FROM `andromeda`.`player_tech_inventory` GROUP BY player_id) i ON i.player_id=u.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) n FROM `andromeda`.`player_tech_slots` GROUP BY player_id) s ON s.player_id=u.id
WHERE COALESCE(i.n,0) <> 5 OR COALESCE(s.n,0) <> 3;
SELECT * FROM `andromeda`.`player_tech_inventory` WHERE tech_id NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 OR amount > 2147483647;
SELECT id, player_id, slot_no FROM `andromeda`.`player_tech_builds`
WHERE ends_at < started_at OR (credited_at IS NULL AND active_slot_no IS NULL)
OR (credited_at IS NOT NULL AND active_slot_no IS NOT NULL);
SELECT b.id AS orphan_build FROM `andromeda`.`player_tech_builds` b LEFT JOIN `andromeda`.`users` u ON u.id=b.player_id WHERE u.id IS NULL;
SELECT use_id, player_id, tech_id, state, reserved_at FROM `andromeda`.`player_tech_use_events`
WHERE state IN ('reserved','needs_review') ORDER BY reserved_at;
